tools.name: connection_status
tools.title: Astra DB connection status
tools.description: Check whether Astra DB credentials are configured and working: where the token, endpoint, and keyspace come from (env, .env, plugin settings, Astra CLI), which database is targeted, and a live connectivity check. Call it first when another tool reports not_configured or an auth error.

check.description: Make a live request to verify the connection (default true).

tools.name: list_databases
tools.title: List Astra databases
tools.description: List the Astra databases this token can access (DevOps API): name, id, status, regions with Data API endpoints, and keyspaces. Use it to choose the `database` argument of other tools.

tools.name: database_overview
tools.title: Astra DB overview
tools.description: Map a database: keyspaces → collections (vector dimension/metric, vectorize model, lexical/rerank, estimated counts) and tables (column and vector-column counts). Start here to see what exists. Renders an interactive overview.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

includeCounts.description: Estimated document counts per collection (one request each).

emit.description: html_file also writes a self-contained HTML page and returns a link to it — only for terminal-only hosts, when the user asks for a visual.

endpoint.description: Data API endpoint of the database this came from; pass it as `database` in follow-up calls.

tools.name: describe_collection
tools.title: Describe collection
tools.description: Show one collection's configuration and shape: vector settings, vectorize and rerank services, lexical, indexing allow/deny, default id type, estimated count, and a sample document with field types. Use before writing queries or code against it.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

emit.description: html_file also writes a self-contained HTML page and returns a link to it — only for terminal-only hosts, when the user asks for a visual.

endpoint.description: Data API endpoint of the database this came from; pass it as `database` in follow-up calls.

tools.name: find
tools.title: Find documents or rows
tools.description: Read documents (collections) or rows (tables) with an optional Data API filter, sort, and projection. Returns pages of 20 plus nextPageState for more. For similarity search use vector_search. Renders an interactive explorer.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

kind.description: Only needed when a collection and a table share the name; otherwise detected.

filter.description: Data API filter, e.g. {"status": "active", "year": {"$gte": 2020}}. Typed ids as {"$uuid": "…"} / {"$objectId": "…"}.

sort.description: Non-vector sort, e.g. {"createdAt": -1}. For similarity use vector_search.

projection.description: Fields to include (1) or exclude (0), e.g. {"title": 1, "author": 1}.

limit.description: Documents to return (rounded up to whole pages of 20).

pageState.description: nextPageState from a previous call, to continue paging.

emit.description: html_file also writes a self-contained HTML page and returns a link to it — only for terminal-only hosts, when the user asks for a visual.

endpoint.description: Data API endpoint of the database this came from; pass it as `database` in follow-up calls.

tools.name: vector_search
tools.title: Vector search
tools.description: Similarity search by natural-language `query` (server-side vectorize), an explicit `vector`, or `documentId` (more like this). `hybrid` combines vector and lexical (BM25) results with reranking on collections that have both. A filter narrows candidates. Returns ranked hits with similarity scores; renders an interactive results view.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

kind.description: Only needed when a collection and a table share the name; otherwise detected.

vector.description: A query embedding (must match the dimension).

documentId.description: Find items similar to this existing document (collections).

idType.description: How to interpret documentId (auto follows the collection's defaultId).

vectorColumn.description: Tables only: which vector column to search (default: the only one).

hybrid.description: Collections with lexical + rerank: combined vector + BM25 search, reranked.

filter.description: Data API filter, e.g. {"status": "active", "year": {"$gte": 2020}}. Typed ids as {"$uuid": "…"} / {"$objectId": "…"}.

projection.description: Fields to include (1) or exclude (0), e.g. {"title": 1, "author": 1}.

emit.description: html_file also writes a self-contained HTML page and returns a link to it — only for terminal-only hosts, when the user asks for a visual.

endpoint.description: Data API endpoint of the database this came from; pass it as `database` in follow-up calls.

tools.name: code_examples
tools.title: Data API code examples
tools.description: Canonical Data API client code for Python (astrapy), TypeScript (@datastax/astra-db-ts), Java, C#, and Go from the bundled, documentation-derived example library. Use when writing application code; snippets read ASTRA_DB_APPLICATION_TOKEN / ASTRA_DB_API_ENDPOINT from the environment.

query.description: What the code should do, e.g. "create a vector collection with vectorize", "find with filter and sort".

mode.description: content: include source; list: file names only.

tools.name: drop
tools.title: Drop collection, table, or index
tools.description: Permanently drop a collection, a table, or a table index, with all its data. Always requires the user's explicit confirmation.

database.description: Database to use: name, id, or Data API endpoint URL. Omit for the configured default.

keyspace.description: Keyspace. Omit for the configured/default keyspace.

name.description: Name of the collection, table, or table index.

confirm.description: Set ONLY after you described the impact and the user approved it in a later message: the exact target name. The original request is not approval; never guess or self-approve.
